shots.card: A bell. One stroke. It does not fade. It hangs.

shots.camText: The nave · 24 mm · slightly above head height, centred on the aisle, symmetrical · a slow drift toward the tower
shots.line: HIEROPHANT: "Heaven chose us from the earth and raised us above the unworthy." (begins)
shots.note: Song: intro, 2 bars. Columns into mist; petals falling at a quarter speed; ten thousand in white; the bell far off, still in the barge's chains.

lines.text: HIEROPHANT: Heaven chose us from the earth

shots.camText: The Hierophant · 50 mm · frontal and symmetrical, past the kneeling couple · a slow push in
shots.line: HIEROPHANT: "… and raised us above the unworthy."
shots.note: His arms rise easily. Frontal, like the building. No face brighter than the white around it.

lines.text: … and raised us above the unworthy.

shots.camText: Behind the bride and groom · 28 mm · low · a tilt up from the kneeling couple to the bell in the barge's chains
shots.note: Height by tilting, not a taller frame (bible). The bell is the darkest thing in the room.

shots.camText: From the gallery · 28 mm · high, looking along the congregation · a slow drift
shots.line: TEN THOUSAND VOICES: "Let no hand bring down."
shots.note: Song: the hook. The response murmured, not shouted: habit, not passion. Banners drifting below the rail.

lines.text: TEN THOUSAND: Let no hand bring down.

shots.camText: Up the open tower · 20 mm · from the tower floor, looking straight up · near-still
shots.line: The barge lets go. Its chains fall slack. The bell settles onto the cathedral's own beam.
shots.note: The kingdom takes its weight. A fall that takes its time: above, everything falls slowly.

shots.camText: The hammer · 35 mm · level with the beam, side on · locked off
shots.line: A hammer the size of a door swings back.
shots.note: Half a bar: the pick-up into the strike.

shots.camText: The strike · 32 mm · from the aisle, looking up at the tower · locked off
shots.note: The strike lands on the downbeat that cuts to Anvil Vale (Q03): the mountain lets go in silence.

shots.camText: END OF Q01 · in the montage, cut to Q03
shots.card: The note hangs. Cut to Anvil Vale: the face of the mountain lets go.
